verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is an API-first platform that is inherently headless. Each request authenticates with API keys over HTTP Basic Auth, and the docs explicitly support command-line testing against a Developer Sandbox, so scripted automation is a first-party capability. Nothing in the evidence addresses CI pipelines specifically, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration guidance, an official CLI or SDK for headless automation, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
